Preston.name: Preston
Preston.description: Trim, focused delivery with clean edges on every consonant and a steady, low-set core that carries through phone bandwidth.

Trevor.name: Trevor
Trevor.description: Buoyant energy over a resonant mid-low core, phrases landing softly and consonants cutting through a handset.

Hugh.name: Hugh
Hugh.description: Soft and close, airy in texture, with lively pitch movement and an attentive, sincere delivery.

Spencer.name: Spencer
Spencer.description: Light and airy, sitting a touch higher, with crisp consonants and a slow, patient delivery.

Edwin.name: Edwin
Edwin.description: Efficient and firm, sincere in attention, with tidy articulation that holds up at phone bandwidth.

Hadley.name: Hadley
Hadley.description: Settled, even-toned and genuinely kind, with crisp consonants that hold up over a handset.

Everly.name: Everly
Everly.description: Rounded, soft-edged tone with gentle lift at the end of phrases and an easy, relaxed delivery.

Delia.name: Delia
Delia.description: Low, grounded and quick to the point, with a sincerity that keeps an apology honest.

Bryony.name: Bryony
Bryony.description: Full, rich mid-range tones, softly relaxed and spoken close to the mic, moving briskly with light pitch play.

Harper.name: Harper
Harper.description: Modern, confident and friendly voice with a standard American accent.

Noa.name: Noa
Noa.description: A glossy, confident young Castilian Spanish voice with fast, girly charm and warmth, a bubbly assistant that makes every chat sparkle.

Lucia-Sol.name: Lucía-Sol
Lucia-Sol.description: A bouncy, chipper young Castilian Spanish voice with a cute upward lilt, bringing playful energy to friendly reception and support.

Rebeca.name: Rebeca
Rebeca.description: Fuller and grounded in the low end, with hard consonant edges and a decisive punch saved for the brand name.

Regina.name: Regina
Regina.description: A confident, upbeat Mexican Spanish adult voice with the natural assurance of a closer. Ideal for proactive assistants and sales-led customer interactions.

Marcos.name: Marcos
Marcos.description: A confident, upbeat Peninsular Spanish adult voice with infectious energy. Perfect for proactive assistants and motivating customer success calls.

Borja.name: Borja
Borja.description: Resonant and punchy, driving a rhythmic read that cuts over a loud music bed and lands squarely on the brand name.

Lalo.name: Lalo
Lalo.description: Fuller and rounder low end, concise phrasing and a decisive drop on the last line, with range to pull back for one clause and push again.

Aldo.name: Aldo
Aldo.description: Forward, close-miked energy with crisp consonant attack and pitch that climbs and drops across a line.

Noemie.name: Noémie
Noemie.description: A young Parisian voice, warm and expressive with a quick playful pace and delicate high notes, a care specialist who stays bright and witty.

Coralie.name: Coralie
Coralie.description: A young Parisian voice, sweet and airy with fast, giggly girly charm, a bubbly assistant who makes every interaction feel light.

Tiphaine.name: Tiphaine
Tiphaine.description: Rounded, low-set tone with even phrasing and consonants that stay crisp through a handset.

Augustin.name: Augustin
Augustin.description: A curious, animated French adult voice that lights up when sharing an unexpected fact. Perfect for geeky explainers and trivia-driven dialogue.

Arnaud.name: Arnaud
Arnaud.description: Low and firm, quick to the point, consonants holding their shape at phone bandwidth.

Jules.name: Jules
Jules.description: A lively, expressive French adult voice that lights up around topics it loves. Great for animated recommendations and high-energy dialogue.

Nele.name: Nele
Nele.description: Rounded, open tone with gentle lift at the ends of phrases and an easy, flowing rhythm.

Jette.name: Jette
Jette.description: An upbeat young German voice with a light girlish tone and warm bounce, a chipper assistant who keeps things moving with a smile.

Annika.name: Annika
Annika.description: A sparky, attentive German adult voice that gets to the point with a smile. Ideal for fast, efficient customer support and helpful voice assistants.

Anton.name: Anton
Anton.description: A vibrant, engaging German adult voice that makes every explanation feel personal. Built for product guides and walk-through assistants.

Mirko.name: Mirko
Mirko.description: Punchy and close-miked in feel, with hard edges on the consonants and a decisive drop on the final line.

Mats.name: Mats
Mats.description: A sparky, attentive German adult voice that gets to the point with a smile. Ideal for fast, efficient customer support and helpful voice assistants.

Manuela-Lu.name: Manuela-Lu
Manuela-Lu.description: A bright, sweet, chirpy young voice with breathless excitement and a constant smile, a warm receptionist who greets everyone like a friend.

Isadora.name: Isadora
Isadora.description: An upbeat young voice with a light girlish tone and warm bounce, quick and to the point, ideal for efficient, caring customer service.

Debora.name: Débora
Debora.description: Low-set and resonant, with firm even phrasing and short decisive sentences.

Davi.name: Davi
Davi.description: A confident, upbeat Brazilian Portuguese adult voice with infectious energy. Perfect for proactive assistants and motivating customer success calls.

Igor.name: Igor
Igor.description: Lifted and lively, pitch moving across a phrase, articulation quick and tidy.

Kaua.name: Kauã
Kaua.description: Sparky and close, with clean attack, brisk rhythm and a decisive push on the final clause that cuts over a loud music bed.
